Name: XdrLogRaider
Author: Alex Kefallonitis
Description: **XdrLogRaider v0.1.0** is a Microsoft Sentinel solution that ingests **Microsoft Defender XDR portal-only telemetry** that the public Graph Security, MDE REST, and Streaming APIs do not expose. Covers 18 Defender XDR sub-areas via 492 read-only endpoints with manifest-driven cadence, pagination, dynamic regionality (TenantContext), per-sub-area circuit-breaker resilience, and ConnectorHeartbeat liveness. Operators bring their own KQL — no analytic rules, workbooks, hunting queries, or parsers in v0.1.0 (data-only ship; content lands in v0.3.0).
DataConnectorsBladeDescription: One data connector — XdrLogRaider — authenticates to security.microsoft.com via session cookies (sccauth + XSRF) and publishes to 19 Log Analytics tables: 18 `Defender_<NodocSubArea>_CL` per sub-area plus 1 `XdrConnectorHealth_CL` ops table.
